reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) reports nanoindentation creep on HfTaTiVZr and TaTiVWZr, showing dislocation-dominated creep with high stress exponents and activation volumes, but it does not test WTaTiVZr, measure toughness or plastic strain, or directly link solid-solution effects to reduced pile-up. The key premises about WTaTiVZr's mechanism are therefore largely unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Atomic size mismatch and uniform dispersion of refractory elements in WTaTiVZr reduce dislocation pile-up
Solid-solution effects lower the activation energy for dislocation motion in the HEA
Reduced dislocation pile-up enhances plastic strain and toughness relative to pure tungsten
Nanoindentation creep parameters (displacement, stress exponent, activation volume) reflect dislocation-mediated deformation
The cited HfTaTiVZr and TaTiVWZr alloys are valid proxies for WTaTiVZr
